title: Merry’s Seven Wishes
description:
How do you say goodbye to someone who was your entire world?

When Richard loses his beloved wife Merry, everything changes. The warmth, the joy, the little things that once made life beautiful — all of it fades away.

His world turns black and white.

Then, one day, he discovers a letter.

Before her death, Merry left him seven final wishes. Seven things she wants him to experience. Seven promises she hopes he'll keep. And perhaps, one last way to remind him that life is still worth living.

What begins as a heartbreaking journey through grief slowly becomes something more.

With every wish, Richard revisits moments of their life together — the laughter, the mistakes, the unexpected joys, and the ordinary days that turned out to mean everything.

Some memories will make you smile. Others may break your heart.

And with each step forward, a little more color returns to his world.

 

SEVEN WISHES. ONE LAST LOVE STORY.Follow Richard as he fulfills the wishes Merry left behind, each revealing another piece of their shared past.

EVERY MEMORY TELLS A STORYExperience the moments that shaped their relationship, from the smallest everyday memories to the ones that changed their lives forever.

BRING COLOR BACK TO THE WORLDWatch Richard's black-and-white world gradually come alive as he rediscovers hope, happiness, and the beauty of living.

Merry's Seven Wishes is an emotional, story-driven visual novel about love, loss, memories, and learning to move forward without forgetting the person who meant everything.

Some love outlives goodbye.
description_short: When Merry dies, Richard's world loses all its color. But she leaves behind seven final wishes — and one last journey for him to take. Relive their most precious memories, rediscover the beauty of love, and slowly bring color back to a world that has turned gray.
